authority_references.source_locator: ASME NQA-1-2015 Part III Introduction and selected guidance
authority_references.applicability_basis: Part III is nonmandatory guidance; use only as an explanatory method for implementing an applicable Part I or invoked Part II requirement.

items.statement: Part III contains nonmandatory guidance for implementing Parts I and II, and alternative methods may satisfy the requirements.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: This part contains nonmandatory guidance on approaches and methods to implement the requirements of Parts I and II.
Alternative approaches and methods may be used to satisfy Parts I and II requirements.

items.statement: Part III guidance may be placed in a QA program or in policies, protocols, instructions, and procedures.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Application of this Part's — Part III — guidance may be achieved by either or both of the following approaches when implementing Parts I and II requirements:

items.statement: Part III guidance says quality assurance should be embedded across work planning, performance, verification, documentation, close-out, and delivery.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Quality assurance is the tool for ensuring that the product meets specified requirements

items.statement: Part III guidance supports a graded approach because items and services may need different levels of control and verification.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Items and services may require varying degrees of control and verification to ensure compliance with requirements.

items.statement: Part III guidance links defined work requirements and tasks to training and qualification needs.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: The definition of work requirements, individual work tasks, and their collection into a work process should be used to determine the individual and collective training and qualification needs.

items.statement: Part III guidance says work objectives should have acceptance criteria and performance should be measured against meaningful parameters.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Work task objectives should be clearly established with in-process and final acceptance criteria.
